下载 .tar.gz 到「下载」文件夹，按 SHA256SUMS 校验后在文件管: Downloads the .tar.gz to your Downloads folder, verifies it against SHA256SUMS and shows it in the file manager. Quit WispOps, unpack it and replace the old folder.
